segments.title: Chương 13: Bố
segments.content:
Chapter 13: Daddy

Two hundred and ten in Comprehensive Science, an average of seventy per subject. In the Olympiad Class, this would only be considered average, but in a parallel class, it was downright absurd. In terms of Comprehensive Science alone, he could rank in the top ten, or even the top five, of the upper echelon.

Out of six subjects, five of them had their health bars showing.

Someone with time on their hands took the score sheets for the five subjects, added them up, and created a ranking list. Among the current top five, there was a name that had never appeared before.

Jiang Nian, 432 points, ranked second.

The lopsided genius ahead of him, Wang Jie, had 210 in Comprehensive Science, 87 in Chinese, and 140 in Math, for a total of 437.

Zhou Yuting ranked third, with fairly balanced scores. Her Comprehensive Science was also an outstanding performance at 200, her Chinese was average at 90, and her Math was 110, totaling four hundred.

This was the norm for parallel classes in the science track: weak foundations and severe subject imbalances.

In the afternoon, Jiang Nian applied ointment for Xu Qianqian.

Song Xiyun was squatting to the side the whole time, watching with a grin and a shy, faint smile on her face. Every time Jiang Nian rubbed for a bit, Song Xiyun would giggle like a little mouse.

"I say, girl, are you in heat?" he couldn't stand it anymore.

"Hmph, hmph, Qianqian, listen to how tactlessly he talks." Song Xiyun threw herself onto Xu Qianqian, acting spoiled, like an imperial concubine demanding justice for her handmaiden.

"He's always been like this. Just don't provoke him."

"Hmm? I get it. Your personal property."

Even Xu Qianqian couldn't maintain her composure. She pinched Song Xiyun and said irritably.

"What are you talking about!"

"Hee hee." Song Xiyun watched with great interest, then turned to ask Jiang Nian, "And you say she isn't. You're already applying medicine for her. I've only ever seen this kind of scene in romance dramas."

"Watch fewer dramas. You're hopeless," Jiang Nian said, his eyes dead.

"Jiang Nian, do you like Qianqian?"

Hearing this, Jiang Nian's hands paused, and an imperceptible blush instantly rose on Xu Qianqian's cheeks.

"Xiyun!"

"Why do you ask that?" Jiang Nian asked.

"Because usually only couples do this. Otherwise, why would you?" Song Xiyun giggled. She just wanted to watch the drama unfold, and the more she watched, the more she shipped them.

"Oh, because she calls me 'Daddy.' You call me 'Daddy,' and if you sprain your ankle, I'll massage it for you too," Jiang Nian said nonchalantly.

Xu Qianqian couldn't take these two anymore. Just as she was about to tell them to stop, she suddenly heard a clear and crisp voice.

"Daddy."

The air froze at that moment. Jiang Nian and Xu Qianqian both turned to look at Song Xiyun.

Song Xiyun blinked, looking at the two of them with a shy expression.

"I was just... livening up the atmosphere."

Damn it! The atmosphere just got even weirder, okay!

After finishing with the ointment, Jiang Nian left, leaving Xu Qianqian to earnestly explain things to Song Xiyun. Things like how there was no special relationship, that it was just a transaction involving math.

Song Xiyun: (>ω<) Teehee.
